verdict.rationale: Beamer is a SaaS changelog and engagement platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask, but nothing in the evidence mentions one. The pack shows only embed code, a WordPress plugin, an API and webhooks (developer building blocks, not a CLI), and the API-related probes (llms.txt, api.md, openapi) all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
